verdict.rationale: Tilled documents pricing templates that let a platform set merchant-facing (sell) rates per payment method, and merchant onboarding/dashboard flows support setting these economics, but the evidence never documents a specific 'buy rate' contract from Tilled itself or interchange-level cost breakdowns for spread visibility. missing for 10: documented buy-rate/cost basis from Tilled, interchange-level fee reporting or reporting API showing cost vs. sell-rate spread, independent confirmation of margin visibility.
